title: Overpriced and poor quality
text:
Overpriced and poor quality. As another reviewer mentioned, this item is of poor quality and extremely overpriced. Parts of the bamboo were already broken off the drawer and others were splintering, the sliding cover fits badly.

If this were $10 or less, it wouldn't bother me, but a rip-off at $50.
